attack_conditioned_robustness.aggregation: full response curves plus explicitly declared mixture functionals
attack_conditioned_robustness.falsifier: ranking or conclusion changes under a substantively plausible declared mixture
attack_conditioned_robustness.indicator: detector success by scheme, attack family, severity, task, language, and payload
attack_conditioned_robustness.scope: dense rows evaluate indexed states directly; they do not assert per-row source extraction, parsing, or execution

bounded_executable_semantics.falsifier: any parse failure or unequal normalized observation
bounded_executable_semantics.indicator: parse success plus exhaustive differential execution over each task's frozen finite domain
bounded_executable_semantics.scope: declared domain and frozen runtime only

evaluation_protocol_transfer.falsifier: all admissible functionals preserve one ordering and every required component maps without changing construct
evaluation_protocol_transfer.indicator: local reimplementations or adaptations of pinned public evaluation definitions on one common 76,032-row indexed-state matrix
evaluation_protocol_transfer.unit: one carrier-specific score under one named evaluation functional

false_positive_control.indicator: exact binomial null tail plus exact binomial uncertainty intervals
false_positive_control.scope: 24 independent fair null bits and frozen acceptance threshold

edge_policies.CodeIP: Local indexed-survivor agreement accepts iff every surviving site matches its original indexed target; zero survivors are accepted vacuously. Interior erasures select indexed targets rather than the pinned repository check's contiguous prefix. Historical available_prefix output keys retain their names for compatibility and do not denote literal repository-prefix scores.
edge_policies.STONE: not computed because the required model-based perplexity component is absent; the published construct is imperceptibility, distinct from this study's human-naturalness interpretation
edge_policies.SWEET: zero-survivor rows have undefined z score and are omitted with counts reported
edge_policies.SrcMarker: deleted payload sites count as incorrect

external_protocol_replay.execution_boundary: full external embedding systems are not run because they require learned-model inference, trained checkpoints, or CUDA outside the frozen resource profile

failure_semantics: parse, runtime, extraction, and bounded-observation mismatches are retained as failures
uncertainty: response-curve Clopper-Pearson fields are two-sided 95% homogeneous independent-Bernoulli reference-model intervals, not confidence intervals for deterministic state enumeration; empirical null intervals and one-sided 95% exact zero-failure bounds require their separately stated independent null-trial model

subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.status: data-only subsequent analysis; no new watermark/attack/detection trials
subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.mapping: 432 of 504 semantic-audit rows link to dense payload-zero/full-severity keys under the reviewed producer; 72 carrier-only rows are outside the dense grid; dense rows lack source hashes and extraction observations
subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.unit: one dense configuration with observed state-model decision and known or unknown bounded semantic label
subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.bound: sharp finite joint-count interval over unrestricted missing binary-label completions
subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.comparator: separately implemented feasible-table enumeration receiving identical observations and optional same-universe marginal
subsequent_joint_evidence_diagnostic.non_claims: no upstream reproduction, external-system defect, source-level robustness result, accuracy gain, or general probability-bound novelty
